quotes.text: If you stay in stealth mode and then you come out and go to market with your product, you better be ready that somebody is vibe coding a tool that's your competitor.
If your point solution fits in the middle of that data flow and doesn't really do anything with the data that's valuable, is it really worth the time?

Whatever you're doing in your current job, the value you're contributing needs to attribute to the person sitting two levels above you. If you have that mindset, you're going to succeed in this industry.
